Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

camp noun

of an army

also army camp, military camp, encampment, pitch camp

classical

Lewis & Short s.v. castrum
Traupman 186
Traupman 286

castra, castrōrum n. pl.

noun, second declension, plural

a military camp

Plural in form, singular in sense: castra pōnere, to pitch camp.

Examples

  • Redībisne crās in castra?

    Will you go back to camp tomorrow?Traupman 182

  • lupus intrāverat castra

    a wolf had got into the campLiv. 21.46.2

See also barracks, army, campsite, camping.
